title: ApePay
tagline: Welcome to the Safe ApeCoin Payment Gateway solution. ApePay is a secure online portal for merchants and institutions that wish to offer ApeCoin and other cryptocurrencies as a payment option.
description:
ApePay is the Safe ApeCoin Payment solution for merchants and institutions that wish to utilise ApeCoin and other cryptocurrencies as a payment option in their day to day business.

ApePay integrates Safe Wallet into a Crypto Payment Gateway that is powered by ApeCoin. 
Using Safe Relay we can abstract users from the transaction fees payment (gas fees) allowing the use of native token or ERC-20 tokens like ApeCoin or $APE token.

In addition to Auth and Multi-Sig wallets, we can also offer payments with crypto and credit card using the built in Stripe or Moneterium payment kits that come with the Safe Protocol.

Once users have completed a transaction then the data will be stored using Tableland which also creates an NFT as the receipt or transaction proof.

Lastly we plan to integrate XMTP for push notifications to send users encrypted email and text messages.

Fast - Get started in minutes with our self-managed product.
Flexible - Accept ApeCoin and a number growing number of cryptocurrencies 
Global - Open your business up to customers around the world.
Costs - Lower fees versus traditional payment methods 


Features:
Minimal gas costs - Optimises gas costs by storing the transaction data that should be executed and the confirmations off-chain.


Safe Smart Wallets -  Utilises Safe to create and manage smart wallets for users. 

Safe Auth kit -  Login via social login methods.
 - No existing wallet needed.
 - Safe logins create and Externally Owned Account or EOA. 
 - The EOA signer is the owner of the smart wallet for the user.
 - The signer is based on an email address for example.

The Auth Kit provides a way to authenticate blockchain accounts using email addresses, social accounts or traditional web3 wallets (ex. Metamask). When using web2 methods as your email or social account, a derived Ethereum address will be generated.


Safe Guards - Makes checks before and after a Safe transaction.
 - The check before a transaction can, e.g. programmatically check all of the parameters of the respective transaction prior to execution.
 - The check after a transaction is called at the very end of the transaction execution and can be used to, e.g. perform checks on the final state of the Safe.


The Relay Kit - Abstract users from the transaction fees payment (gas fees) allowing the use of native token or ERC-20 tokens. 
This will enable you to pay transaction fees directly from funding available in a Safe


Off-Chain Signing - Safe offers off-chain transaction signing as a new default.
The signing request will be blocked until the message is fully signed and then return the signature as a string. 
As Safe is a multi signature wallet, this process can take some time because multiple signers may need to sign the message.


Monerium IBAN, your fiat gateway
The Monerium IBAN is directly connected to your blockchain address enables you to seamlessly collect and send euros between bank accounts and blockchains over the SEPA network.
how_its_made:
ApePay integrates Safe {Wallet} features to offer users a well rounded payment solution. This includes utilising the Gelato Relay to allow fees to be paid in any ERC-20 token of choice, enter ApeCoin. With many different option we wanted to offer users a platform that allows for multi-sig wallet payments as well as credit card payments in one user interface.

Once a user has successfully made a payment, the features of the Tableland protocol allows users to store their payment data in a one of a kind SQL solution, essentially allowing NFT's to be utilised as payment receipts

Last but not least we aim to integrate XMTP to allow push notification of successful payments.
